name: week
title: Literature review week
subtitle: Synthetic demonstration records until your own data is imported.

sections.title: Review deadlines
sections.sql: select * from review_week order by due_on

sections.title: Decision queue
sections.sql: select review,code,name,owner,status,due_on from record_status where status like '%pending' or status like '%conflict' order by due_on

sections.title: Findings
sections.sql: select r.code review,c.reference,c.rule,c.detail from compliance_findings c join reviews r on r.id=c.review_id order by review,rule

sections.title: Extraction checks
sections.sql: select * from extraction_queue order by code,field

sections.title: Reports by status
sections.sql: select review,status,count(*)::integer reports,count(distinct nullif(study_key,''))::integer linked_studies from record_status group by review,status order by review,status
sections.note: Counts cover records held here. They are not a complete PRISMA flow diagram. Study keys group multiple reports.
